description: The portion library the Spawner writes in answer to a node_catalog_query (architecture §3.13.3, implementation §10.1): every entry of the Specialty Catalog as the answering network sees it, the artifact storage, and the bundles.

artifact_ref.description: The digest of the entry's image, which names it (implementation §1.2.11).

state.description: In the answering network: active if an instance of it runs, archived if none runs and its floor history records an archiving, registered if it never ran (architecture §3.13.3). Known values: active, archived, registered.

capability_text.description: What the blueprint knows how to do (architecture §3.13.3).

acquisition.description: The acquisition cost of the answering network, absent if it has none (architecture §3.13.3).

provenance.description: Known values: derived, purchased, imported, seeded.

active_floors.description: The similarity_floor of each instance that runs it today, read from the Active Node Registry (architecture §3.13.3).

floor_history.description: One row per floor with which it ran on the answering network and was archived (architecture §3.13.3).

trigger_reason.description: That of the archiving: a value of node_review's, or one the Spawner archives with on its own (architecture §3.12.3, §3.13.8, §3.13.10).

model_id.description: The vector space in which the floor makes sense.

snapshot.description: The metrics snapshot of the archiving: the signal vector of architecture §3.12.2. Absent if the row has none.

artifact_size.description: Bytes the artifact takes in the image registry beyond the base image (architecture §3.13.3).

deletion_mark.description: Its image is deleted or being deleted (architecture §3.13.8).

veto_mark.description: The answering network vetoed the artifact (architecture §3.13.8).

present_in.description: The networks of the tenant with a current presence mark on it (architecture §3.13.3).

storage_occupied.description: Bytes of artifact storage occupied: the artifact_size of the entries without a deletion mark (architecture §3.13.3).

storage_capacity.description: Bytes of artifact storage the deployment declares (architecture §3.13.3).

bundles.description: The bundles, which the Operator Channel expands to instantiate them (architecture §3.13.6, §3.17.1).
